name: Fly-HDMI5
description: A 5 inch IPS HDMI touchscreen display with USB-C touch interface. Supports direct FPC connection to FLY host boards (FLY-PI-V2, FLY-C8, FLY-PRO-X10) as well as standard HDMI cable connection to any SBC.

connectionSpecs.connector: Mini HDMI + USB-C (or FPC direct-connect to FLY boards)

features: IPS panel with wide viewing angles
FPC direct-connect to FLY host boards
Standard HDMI connection for any SBC
